name: Limits Breaker portrait and equipment illustration system
role: runtime fallback drawing only; displayed portraits and item icons use primary PNG raster art
disclosure: Godot code drawing is only a missing-file fallback; player, skeleton, brigand, warden and cultist portraits use Cloudflare FLUX Schnell, while the colossus, Limitless, blacksmith and angel use local PNG raster art.
style: Dark medieval fantasy medallions with readable silhouettes, shared ink outlines, restrained steel, burgundy, violet, and warm gold accents.
renderer: Godot CanvasItem draw commands used only when a raster asset is missing.
